text:
Elliot: Heads up: thinking of doing a mini 'Summit Week' next week - low-key skill-share + a handicap 5K on Friday morning. Who's in? :mountain: :running_man:
Sam: Love this. Quick ask - can we include a crash course on top-rope to lead transition? I have a pair of trainers who could demo.
Priya: In for the 5K. Handicap sounds fun (I volunteer to be the slow starter :sweat_smile:). What time Friday?
Jared: If we do a 7:15am run people can still make breakfast. Also happy to run the anchors/gear mini-session at lunch.
Elliot: Plan: Tuesday 12:15pm - 'Anchors 101' (30 min live demo in rooftop alcove). Thursday 12:15pm - short panel on warmups & injury prevention. Friday 7:15am - handicap 5K (start at office, loop around waterfront).
Priya: Can we have a sign-up for pace markers? Prefer not to get lost in a pack. Maybe do 6, 7, 8, 9 min/km groups.
Sam: I'll bring a headset + speaker for the demo. Also will bring extra slings & a couple of quickdraws for hands-on practice (no live lead climbing, just anchor building).
Jared: WellnessBot: created event 'Summit Week: Anchors 101' Tue 12:15. Reminder 10m before.
Elliot: Also tiny fun: handicap rule - each person writes their 5K PR on a sticky, we randomize handicaps so finish order is mixed. Could hand out mini medals (stickers).
Priya: Cute. I'll design a paper bib template. :art:
Sam: Count me in for all sessions. If anyone needs a running headset or tempo cues I can pace.
Jared: Coffee meetup after Friday run? Espresso cart near dock opens at 8.
Elliot: :thumbsup: I'll post a short RSVP message later with pace buckets. Anyone else?
